| notes = "'''Hark! The Herald Angels Sing'''", originally titled "'''Hymn for Christmas-Day'''", is a Christmas carol by Charles Wesley. It was first published in ''[[Hymns and Sacred Poems]]'' in 1739, and was subsequently altered slightly by several authors including [[Author:George Whitefield|George Whitefield]].

Wesley originally intended the hymn to be sung to the anonymous tune ''[[Easter Hymn (tune)|Easter Hymn]]'' (often credited to [[Author:John Worgan|John Worgan]]), but it is nearly always sung instead to the tune '''''[[Mendelssohn]]'''''. This latter was written by [[Author:Felix Mendelssohn|Felix Mendelssohn]] for the cantata ''[[Festgesang]]'', and was adapted to fit the hymn lyrics by [[Author:William H. Cummings|William H. Cummings]].
}}
